duration: Saturdays 1 to 4 p.m., February 6 to April 24, 2027 (no sessions March 20 and 27)
name: Saturday Morning Quantum* in Chicago
what_you_do: Take a free 10 class series on quantum science and engineering. Experts lead it. It shows you Fermilab careers and may include tours of Fermilab. Finishing can help with future internships and college portfolios.
who_can_apply: Open to all high school students across Illinois. No science prerequisite. You must attend at least 8 sessions, with no excused absences.
deadline_text: Applications for Spring 2027 will open in late fall 2026. Classes run February 6 to April 24, 2027.
how_to_apply: Watch the program page for the application. It opens in late fall 2026. If you have questions, write to Saturdaymorningquantum@fnal.gov.
notes: Classes are held at the Olive Harvey Learning Center, 3055 East 92nd Street, Chicago. The page gives no exact open or close date for applications.
